study: Blue whales Eastern North Pacific 1993-2008 - Argos Data
citation: Mate BR, Palacios DM, Irvine LM, Bailey H, Follett TM (2019) Data from: Behavioural estimation of blue whale movements in the Northeast Pacific from state-space model analysis of satellite tracks. Movebank Data Repository.
processing: Cleaned for display: removed positions the researchers flagged as errors, invalid satellite fixes, and jumps faster than a blue whale can swim (over 12 km/h); kept at most one position per 4 hours. Lines break where the tag went 3+ days without a fix.
